title: Gary Smulyan on what jazz is
summary: Rowe reads Gary Smulyan's four-part definition of jazz; DiBlasio agrees.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Oh. I feel like I put a big downer on it.
I’ve seen you in pictures with Gary Smulyan.

I wanted to read something he said, and then see maybe you can top him like a battle. Like a baritone battle. He said, “There’s this misconception like oh I’m a jazz man, I play what I feel, man. And that’s not what it is. Jazz is four things you have to hook up. What you think, what you can hear, what you can feel, and what you can execute on your horn.
Yeah. Well there’s no battle there.
